basic_profile.bio: A die-hard Montreal Canadiens fan, I've been following the team since I was a kid growing up in Quebec. I'm a 32-year-old computer engineer currently residing in Montreal. In my free time, I enjoy gaming, especially submarine simulators, and have a passion for collecting Bionicle figures. I'm also preparing for potential societal shifts by engaging in collapse preparedness activities. Typically, I'm online during late evenings after work. I'm single and enjoy spending weekends exploring local hiking trails.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I hold a bachelor's degree in computer engineering from McGill University. My expertise lies in software development, with a particular interest in simulation games. Much of my knowledge is self-taught, as I enjoy tinkering with technology in my free time. I'm also well-versed in hockey statistics and strategy, which I've picked up through years of watching games and participating in online forums.
